name: Blazing Rift
flavour: A seam of open flame across black rock. The heat rewards those who carry it and punishes everyone else.

name: Tide of Trials
flavour: Cold water to the chest, rising and falling. Nothing here stays where you left it.

name: Whisperwind Arena
flavour: An open ring of standing stones. The wind carries every sound and hides every step.

name: Tenebris Abyss
flavour: No floor that anyone has found. Something down there is paying attention.

name: Chronos Cradle
flavour: A room that has already happened. Fighters here learn not to trust the last thing they remember.

name: Aurora Sanctum
flavour: Vaulted ice lit from beneath. The Herald's own ground, and it forgives more than it should.
